svg.title: Joseph Kawe — developer
svg.desc: An isometric neon-lit room: a desk with code on the monitor, a gaming chair, a bookcase, and a TV showing a space invader above an NES. Beside it, the name Joseph Kawe and a neon sign cycling through NestJS, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vue, Laravel, Three.js, Cloudflare.
